[SWS_DM_00877] Starting time-based event debouncing for failed
⌈
The
DM module shall start the debounce timer when the related monitor calls the method
ReportMonitorAction ([SWS_DM_00543]) with kPrefailed ([SWS_DM_00541])
to qualify the reported event as kFinallyDefective only when the following condi-
tions are met:
• The debounce timer for the event is not already counting towards kFinallyDe-
fective.
• The event is not already qualified as kFinallyDefective.
⌋
